source_locator.edition_or_translation: J. M. Ashmand translation from Proclus's Greek paraphrase; 1900 W. Foulsham & Co. new edition
source_locator.section: Signs Commanding and Obeying; cross-reference Chapter XX
source_locator.short_quote: those in the winter semicircle, obeying

calculation_dependencies: sign position within the winter semicircle

condition.sign_list_basis: cross-chapter identification of winter with the lunar semicircle

normalized_rule: Classify the signs in the winter semicircle as obeying; the Aquarius-to-Cancer list follows a cross-chapter lunar-semicircle identification.
synthesis_notes: This is a source-specific sign relationship, not a claim about social power or personality behavior.
review_notes: The obeying definition is in Chapter XVII. The Aquarius-to-Cancer list is a cross-chapter inference from the lunar semicircle, while Chapter XVII's equal-distance-from-an-equinoctial criterion remains a separate relationship; no universal later interpretation is imported.
transmission_notes: The obeying classification is stated in the Ashmand/Proclus main text; the explicit Aquarius-to-Cancer list is cross-referenced within Book I and is not an explicit equation in the cited passage. The equal-distance criterion is preserved separately.
